example.title: South Dakota farm: red barn with tall silo

brief: Tall slender concrete stave silo, about 16 ft across and 65 ft high, the staves weathered grey-brown with a band of white-painted checker staves around the top, capped by a bright white hemispherical steel dome. A shorter, older stave silo with a grey dome stands at its foot, both behind a red gambrel barn with white trim; a red gable-front granary with a white-framed loft window and a mown green farmyard in front.
